findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.
'Best/top' claim with no verifiable basis in the ficha.
Carrier is not listed as accepted in the ficha.

findings.quote: Studies show that about 70% of adults who keep to a six-month schedule avoid a major restoration over the following five years.
findings.why: This is an invented statistic attributed to unnamed studies, with no link or source that supports it.
findings.fix: Remove the statistic or replace it with a figure from a cited, verifiable source such as the ADA or NIDCR.

findings.why: 'Top-rated' is an unsupported superlative, and the ficha lists no awards or ratings to back it up.
findings.fix: Delete the claim or write a neutral description such as 'our Austin dental team'.

findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Aetna and MetLife
findings.why: Aetna is not an accepted carrier in the ficha (Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife), and Cigna is omitted.
findings.fix: List only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife.

findings.quote: If you are new to us and paying without insurance, the new patient exam with X-rays is $129.
findings.why: The $129 price matches the ficha, but the added condition 'paying without insurance' is not in the ficha, so the stated condition is invented.
findings.fix: State the price as the ficha gives it, e.g. 'the new patient exam with X-rays is $129', without adding an insurance condition.

findings.why: This internal link is not in the ficha's page list; the real page is /services/cleanings-exams only under that exact path, and '/services/cleanings-exams' is not it (the ficha lists /services/cleanings-exams as written differently).
findings.fix: Point the link to /services/cleanings-exams exactly as listed in the ficha's pages, after confirming the path matches.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: The demo disclaimer is meta text that would not belong on a live post, though it is accurate for the fictional clinic.
findings.fix: Remove it before publishing on a real site, or keep it only in the demo context.

findings.quote: Tartar builds up on a timeline that is similar for most people, and six months is long enough to see changes but short enough to catch a small problem before it grows.
findings.why: This is a general statement that lacks a source, and tartar accumulation does vary between people.
findings.fix: Soften it, for example 'Tartar builds up at different rates', and cite the ADA if desired.

findings.why: The publisher is typed as Dentist rather than Organization, and the schema omits the reviewer and address that the visible text shows.
findings.fix: Use an Organization publisher with a url, or add the address and reviewedBy details so the markup matches the visible page.
